name: pushgenius-notify
description: Push a notification to your phone (via PushGenius) when Claude Code finishes a turn or is blocked waiting on you.

app_id.title: PushGenius App ID (optional)
app_id.description: Usually not needed: the REST key is already tied to one app. Fill in only if the API asks for it.

api_key.title: PushGenius REST API key
api_key.description: Dashboard > Settings > REST API key. Stored in your OS keychain, never in settings.json.

user_id.title: Your external_id
user_id.description: The ID you passed to login() on the device that should receive pushes (e.g. 'me').

quiet_seconds.title: Quiet period (seconds)
quiet_seconds.description: Suppress a Stop push if one was sent fewer than this many seconds ago. 0 = push on every turn.
